messages:
sophie: Quick idea  add an 'undo token' + preview-mode for runtime config applies. Let teams preview impact and get a short-lived token to revert quickly.

jamal: How's this different from our rollback docs/playbooks?

sophie: Two things: token is issued atomically with the commit and encodes the exact delta; and it's short-lived (TTL) for fast, deterministic reverts.

meera: Preview-mode: are we talking dry-run routing logs, or actually shadowing a sampled cohort?

sophie: Both optional. Preview can run dry-run decision logs or route a tiny shadow sample through the real runtime. We'll surface sim_metrics: token_cost_delta, p95 latency delta, error-class shifts.

alex: Security notes: tokens are scoped to org/team, audited, and TTL enforced. Must be HSM-backed for signing.

kevin: API sketch: POST /v1/configs/apply?preview=true -> {preview_id, sim_metrics}; commit with request_undo_token=true returns undo_token and expiry. Revert via POST /v1/configs/revert with undo_token.

sophie: Example payloads:
POST /v1/runtime/configs/apply
body: {"changes":[...], "preview":true, "shadow_sample":0.001}
returns: {"preview_id":"pv_123", "sim_metrics":"{token_cost_delta:0.12, p95_latency_ms:7.3}"}

POST /v1/runtime/configs/apply
body: {"changes":[...], "preview":false, "request_undo_token":true}
returns: {"config_id":"cfg_234", "undo_token":"ut_xxx", "undo_ttl_secs":"3600"}

meera: Sandbox must pin model/version and use identical batching/cache paths so sim metrics are meaningful.

jamal: Server-side token = signed blob(commit_id, changeset_hash, exp). Need key rotation and KMS/HSM.

alex: Token issuance should create an audit entry linking user -> commit -> token. Using token triggers an audited rollback trace.

kevin: Console UX: show safety window countdown, one-click revert, sim_metrics and cost delta. Also an option to enable automated telemetry gating that auto-reverts if drift exceeds threshold.

sophie: Telemetry gating: example policy: revert if error_rate increases > 0.5% absolute within first 20m. But must keep sim cohort labeled to avoid contamination.

meera: Important: undo must revert only that commit's authoritative server-side state. If downstream services applied side-effects, revert may be partial; document this. Also handle overlapping commits carefully.

jamal: Edge-case: expired token -> fallback to manual inverse apply. Console should warn prominently when token TTL is low/expired.

kevin: Implementation outline:
- apply creates commit object with changeset + commit_id
- if request_undo_token: sign {commit_id, changeset_hash, exp} with KMS and store pointer in commit metadata
- preview path: dry-run engine or route shadow cohort through sandboxed routing layer; flag telemetry so sim_metrics are computed separately

sophie: Load concerns: sandboxing adds extra work. Default shadow_sample 0.1% and cap per-tenant. Charge sandbox quota so cost is transparent.

opsbot: deploy-bot: canary-apply-simulator v1.2 deployed to staging at 2026-02-11T15:22:43Z :white_check_mark:

meera: We should cache dry-run results for identical predicates/inputs to keep previews cheap. Cache invalidation keyed by changeset_hash + model_version + routing_seed.

jamal: Console metrics to display: token_cost_delta, p50/p95 latency delta, error delta, kv_cache_hit_rate delta, quota burn delta, sample size, and confidence intervals.

alex: Add reversible flag to commit metadata and an "undo lineage" view for audits to query reverted commits.

kevin: Next steps: 1) RFC with API proto + console mockups. 2) minimal server: commit + token issuance + revert endpoint. 3) demo on a small internal service.

sophie: I'll draft the RFC and mockups. Tagging @meera and @jamal for review, cc @alex for security/ops constraints. Thanks :heart:
